column1: The Statements present figures which are rounded-off to ₹ in lakh and ₹ in crore as depicted at
the top of the respective Statements.
Minor difference of ₹ 0.01/0.02 lakh/crore, wherever occurring, between the Summary
Statements and Detailed Statements in Volume-I and Volume-II respectively, is due to
rounding up/down to the next lakh/crore figure.
